verdict.rationale: Productboard's official hosted MCP server lets users drive the product in natural language from agents like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Codex. Users can add features, reschedule initiatives, move initiatives to releases, update prioritization drivers, and create or update most entities. Its built-in Spark agent also accepts natural-language chat for synthesis and connected-tool actions. Missing for 10: clear documentation that the native Spark agent can directly operate core Productboard entities by command, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliable the natural-language operation is.
